attchmntText: Rana Sugars Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rana Sugars Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Quarterly and Half Yearly Financial Results for the period ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss before tax of 2797.48 Lakhs for the six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a profit of 3638.47 Lakhs in the previous year. Basic earnings per share stood at negative 1.63 for the six-month period. The Statutory Auditor issued a Limited Review Report on these results. The Board also took on record the Statement of Cash Flows and Statement of Assets and Liabilities for the six months ended September 30, 2026. An extract of the results will be published in newspapers as per Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Rana Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Rana Ranjit Singh as Chairman of the company w.e.f. October 01, 2026.
Rana Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Rana Ranjit Singh as Chairman and Non-Executive Director of the company w.e.f. October 01, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rana Sugars Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and The BSE Limited regarding the resignation of Mr. Rana Ranjit Singh, holding DIN 00076770, from the positions of Chairman and Non-Executive Director. The resignation is effective from 01st October, 2026, due to health-related issues and his consequent inability to continue as a Director. The company cites Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015 for this intimation. Mr. Singh confirmed that his resignation is voluntary and solely due to health reasons, with no other material causes. He is not holding directorships in any other listed entities. The resignation letter and required details under Schedule III of the SEBI regulations are enclosed with the filing.
